record.paper_title: Homogeneous manifolds whose geodesics are orbits. Recent results and some open problems
record.original_question: Extend key Riemannian criteria for homogeneous geodesics to pseudo-Riemannian homogeneous manifolds. In particular, formulate pseudo-Riemannian analogues of algebraic tests for when one-parameter curves gamma(t)=exp(t(a+x)).o are geodesics and for when multi-exponential curves gamma(t)=exp(tX)exp(tY)exp(tZ).o are geodesics, while accounting for the pseudo-Riemannian possibility that a homogeneous null geodesic has a non-affine parameter.

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $(M=G/H,g)$ be a pseudo-Riemannian homogeneous manifold, where $G$ is a connected Lie group acting transitively by isometries on $M$, $H$ is the isotropy subgroup at a base point $o\in M$, and $g$ is a $G$-invariant pseudo-Riemannian metric. Let $\mathfrak{g}=\mathrm{Lie}(G)$ and $\mathfrak{h}=\mathrm{Lie}(H)$, and (when available) fix a reductive decomposition $\mathfrak{g}=\mathfrak{h}\oplus\mathfrak{m}$ with $\mathrm{Ad}(H)\mathfrak{m}\subseteq\mathfrak{m}$, so that $\mathfrak{m}$ is identified with $T_oM$ and the metric $g_o$ corresponds to a (possibly indefinite) non-degenerate $\mathrm{Ad}(H)$-invariant scalar product $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$ on $\mathfrak{m}$.

A smooth curve $\gamma:\mathbb{R}\to M$ with $\gamma(0)=o$ is called a homogeneous geodesic if it is an orbit of a one-parameter subgroup of $G$, i.e. $\gamma(t)=\exp(tZ)\cdot o$ for some $Z\in\mathfrak{g}$, and if it is a geodesic of $g$ up to a possibly non-affine reparametrization (this last freedom being needed because a null orbit curve may be a geodesic only after reparametrization).

Solve the following two problems.

(1) (Single-exponential criterion.) Find necessary and sufficient algebraic conditions on $a\in\mathfrak{h}$ and $x\in\mathfrak{m}$ such that the curve
$$\gamma(t)=\exp\bigl(t(a+x)\bigr)\cdot o$$
is, after possibly a non-affine reparametrization, a geodesic of $(M,g)$. The conditions should be expressed purely in terms of the Lie brackets in $\mathfrak{g}$, the projection $\mathfrak{g}\to\mathfrak{m}$, and the scalar product $\langle\cdot,\cdot\rangle$, and must reduce, in the Riemannian (positive definite) case, to the classical Kowalski–Vanhecke geodesic lemma:
$$\langle [a+x,y]_\mathfrak{m},x\rangle=0\quad\text{for all } y\in\mathfrak{m}.$$
The pseudo-Riemannian formulation must explicitly allow for a constant $k=k(x)\in\mathbb{R}$ accounting for the case where the orbit parameter $t$ is not an affine parameter of $\gamma$, which can occur when $x$ is null.

(2) (Triple-exponential criterion.) Find necessary and sufficient algebraic conditions on $X,Y,Z\in\mathfrak{g}$ such that the curve
$$\gamma(t)=\exp(tX)\exp(tY)\exp(tZ)\cdot o$$
is, after possibly a non-affine reparametrization, a geodesic of $(M,g)$. The conditions must reduce, in the Riemannian case, to the known algebraic test for three-exponential homogeneous geodesics, and must account for the same non-affine-parameter phenomenon for null orbits.
artifact.status_search_result: A pseudo-Riemannian "geodesic lemma" for single one-parameter orbits γ(t)=exp(t(a+x)).o has been established by Dušek and others, in which a constant k=k(x) accommodating the non-affine parameter on null orbits explicitly appears; existence of at least one homogeneous geodesic through each point of a reductive pseudo-Riemannian homogeneous space is also known in the affine setting, although general existence remains subtle. The analogous algebraic criterion for triple-exponential curves exp(tX)exp(tY)exp(tZ).o in full pseudo-Riemannian generality does not appear to be established in the literature in the same complete form as in the Riemannian case, so the program is partially solved.

status_evidence.title: The existence of homogeneous geodesics in homogeneous pseudo-Riemannian and affine manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Geodesic Lemma involving a constant k(T) that vanishes unless T is null, giving the pseudo-Riemannian analogue of the Riemannian criterion.
status_evidence.claim: A pseudo-Riemannian geodesic lemma with non-affine-parameter constant exists for one-parameter orbits.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneous geodesics in pseudo-Riemannian nilmanifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Studies homogeneous geodesics in pseudo-Riemannian nilmanifolds using the geodesic lemma adapted to indefinite metrics.
status_evidence.claim: The single-exponential criterion has been extended to pseudo-Riemannian nilmanifolds.

status_evidence.title: Homogeneous geodesics of non-reductive homogeneous pseudo-Riemannian 4-manifolds
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses homogeneous geodesics also in non-reductive pseudo-Riemannian settings.
status_evidence.claim: Extensions of the criterion exist also for non-reductive pseudo-Riemannian homogeneous spaces.
